src: “Quite so,” he answered, lighting a cigarette, and throwing himself down into an armchair.

src: “The facts are briefly these: Some five years ago, during a lengthy visit to Warsaw, I made the acquaintance of the well-known adventuress, Irene Adler.

src: “Let me see!” said Holmes.

src: If this young person should produce her letters for blackmailing or other purposes, how is she to prove their authenticity?”

src: “Was the photograph a cabinet?”

src: So accustomed was I to his invariable success that the very possibility of his failing had ceased to enter into my head.
